trace_rule: UI source → command → canonical owner → validation/permission → mutation/operation → event/receipt/ObservableWork → UI projection → Usage/diagnostic attribution → recovery/deep link
note: Every trace ends with demo_note: concept-local state is simulated and labeled; nothing masquerades as production wiring.

traces.validation_permission: managed/unavailable sources blocked with receipt; typed values
traces.ui_projection: row re-render with Custom badge; view cache invalidated
traces.usage_diagnostic_attribution: n/a in demo; production attributes to schema revision
traces.recovery_deep_link: Reset to default in row Details; #/cat/<cat>/<sub>?row=<id> restores focus

traces.canonical_owner: Each family's plan owner once ids land in inventory
traces.recovery_deep_link: route re-render restores last value from synState
traces.demo_note: Fixture rows are explicitly not inventory ids; production wiring deferred to family owners.

traces.validation_permission: unknown-owner installations manual-only (button replaced by note)
traces.usage_diagnostic_attribution: confidence + host surfaced as diagnostic evidence

traces.validation_permission: ask-first policy honored; nothing proceeds without approval
traces.ui_projection: status card transitions; rolled-back badge fixture
traces.usage_diagnostic_attribution: verification receipt doubles as diagnostic evidence
traces.recovery_deep_link: rollback fixture restores previous generation with receipt kept
traces.demo_note: Simulated phases; determinate only with denominator (3).

traces.mutation_or_operation: timed op; last-known-good stays active on failure (ollama fixture)
traces.demo_note: Simulated network round-trip with wait reason.

traces.validation_permission: entry resolved via PMSearch2.byRid only; unavailable entries never route
traces.event_receipt: none on navigation; landing highlight pm2-locate
traces.ui_projection: domain/manager view with exact row/section highlighted and focused
traces.recovery_deep_link: browser Back restores #/q/<query> with query text and identical grouped results

traces.ui_source: Copy flow step buttons (source, categories, preview, apply, rollback)
traces.validation_permission: credential rows copied as references only; unavailable rows skipped
traces.event_receipt: apply receipt with counts; verify gaps surfaced
traces.recovery_deep_link: Roll back this copy → restore point rollback receipt

traces.control_family: action rows (backup now, rebuild gists, trace path)
traces.ui_source: PMManagers2 action controls and famRow actions
traces.validation_permission: rate limits on test sends; dry-run first for cleanup
